name: Biren Technology Hot Chips 34 presentation 'BR100 GPGPU: Accelerating Datacenter Scale AI Computing'
notes: First-party (vendor conference) source for the Biren BR100's two interconnect figures, which had no record in this repo. Spec slide: 'Host Interface PCIe Gen5 x16 w/CXL', 'Interconnections 8 BLink', '2.3TB/s external I/O bandwidth'. Chiplet slide: '896GB/s high speed die-to-die interconnect' and 'One tapeout to empower multiple SKUs'. Server topology slide shows BR100 OAM with '550W OAM form factor with 8 cards all-to-all interconnection topology'. NOTE the slide carries its own confidentiality legend ('Confidential. This document contains confidential information of BirenTechnology'), so it is a vendor primary source but a weak one to cite for a shipping configuration.
